pass_meta.suite: Global Search V2 - V1 regression set
pass_meta.scope: the permission-gated cases that were Blocked for want of a suitable user
pass_meta.how_judged: The subject's OWN permission list was read after switching to them, not the role form's read-back - the two disagreed earlier in the day, and only the subject's list says what the user can do. Every search carries a positive control: a query that must still return something for this user, so that an empty Work Orders group is distinguishable from an empty search.

C45142.observed: A user who can see work orders gets work-order results: typing 9160 returned twenty jobs and typing Bridgeport returned six. A user whose role does not include work-orders access gets none at all - the Work Orders group does not even appear for them - while their customers and vehicles come back exactly as before. Typing 9160 gave that user two customers and no jobs; typing Bridgeport gave seven customers and one vehicle and no jobs.
C45142.technical: User A: Clayton Stephens on Technician, six permissions including workOrdersView. User B: the same person moved to a purpose-built role holding ONE permission, customersView. Note for whoever repeats this: unchecking Work orders / View on a stock role does NOT remove workOrdersView (it swaps the technician view mode for the full one), and every stock role on this branch carries it - so User B has to be a role created from scratch. The role used is ZZAUTOTEST No Work Orders; Clayton was put back on Technician afterwards and the Technician role was restored control by control to its recorded baseline.
